verdict.rationale: Riskified's docs state it "stands behind its chargeback guarantee for all approved orders," which is the liability shift this story asks for. Chargebacks on approved orders are reported through a dedicated chargeback endpoint or through automated gateway integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, PayPal), so the claim flow is concrete. Missing for 10: published coverage terms (exclusions, eligible chargeback reason codes, caps, time windows), documented reimbursement mechanics and payout timing, and independent or hands-on confirmation that claims are actually paid.
